digest.component_or_area: Jira Cloud ADF codec / Rich text conversion
propositions: Cloud ADF encode (text_to_adf) treats markdown syntax as literal characters rather than structured nodes, requiring a markdown-aware encode function
Repeated round-trip conversion of combined marks (strong+strikethrough) oscillates between two states indefinitely due to mark-order instability
Markdown-to-ADF conversion via marklas drops HTML comments present in source, including rebar's own reconciler-echo marker
Three pure functions (markdown_to_adf, adf_to_markdown, fit_markdown_to_adf_limit) must be added with lazy marklas import and plain-text fallback, not integrated into the live AdfCodec path
Over a 360-body corpus fixture, round-trip MD→ADF→MD conversion must reach fixed point for ≥99.6% of bodies with ≥15% structurally rich (non-paragraph block nodes)
